APPROVE
The extracted helpers preserve the original short-circuit order and conditions (the De Morgan inversion in `ReturnValueIsConstant` is correct, and the extra `k > 0` in `IsSenderCall` always holds on the expression-body path because `k` starts at `body.Start + 1`). The remaining method lands at roughly 13, under the threshold, and the change introduces no unused variables or other build-breaking constructs.
